newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ASC freezes money from some TNT trades.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ASC freezes money from some TNT trades.

text.p: The Australian Securities Commission (ASC) said on Friday it had frozen the proceeds from the TNT Ltd options trades identified by the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) as being suspicious.
"There have been freezing orders placed on the proceeds from the options trades that the ASX identified as being suspicious," an ASC spokeswoman told Reuters.

The ASX and the ASC said on Thursday said they had begun an investigation into options trading in TNT Ltd just before the transport group received a friendly A$2.0 billion takeover bid from Dutch post and telecoms giant Koninklijke PTT Nederland (KPN).

The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX), which first took notice of trading in TNT options last week, said it regarded the matter very seriously and had asked the Australian Securities Commission to begin a formal investigation.
